about.title: Welcome to Perfume Zone
about.leadText: Born from an obsession with rare aromas and rich Arabian heritage, Perfume Zone brings the world's most evocative fragrances directly to fragrance lovers across the United Kingdom.
about.storyParagraph1: At Perfume Zone (perfumezone.uk), we believe that fragrance is not merely an accessory; it is an intimate expression of individuality, memory, and presence. Founded in the United Kingdom, our mission started with a clear vision: to bridge the gap between historic perfume houses in Dubai, Oman, and Grasse, and the discerning fragrance enthusiasts of the UK.
about.storyParagraph2: From the deep, resinous allure of Cambodian and Hindi Agarwood (Oud) to the delicate sweetness of Taif Roses, warm ambergris, and delectable gourmand notes, our curation represents the pinnacle of oriental and modern niche perfumery.

values.title: 100% Genuine Authenticity
values.desc: Every single bottle in our catalog is sourced directly from original manufacturers and authorized distributors. We guarantee absolute authenticity with batch codes and proof of provenance.

values.title: Artisanal Extrait Concentrations
values.desc: We champion high-concentration formulations—Extrait De Parfum and Eau De Parfum—ensuring remarkable longevity, projection, and depth that evolve on skin throughout the day.

values.title: Curated Scent Wardrobe
values.desc: Whether you seek a signature daily office fragrance, a sultry evening oud, or a fresh summer breeze accord, our team selects each creation for its outstanding artistic merit.

about.dispatchText: Operating from our central logistics hub in London, all orders placed on perfumezone.uk are carefully packaged in luxury protective cases to ensure pristine delivery to your doorstep. We are proud to offer free standard delivery across the United Kingdom on orders over £50.

faq.pageSubtitle: Find fast answers regarding genuine authenticity, UK tracked shipping, order fulfillment, and fragrance care.

items.q: Are all fragrances on perfumezone.uk 100% authentic?
items.a: Yes, without exception. At Perfume Zone (perfumezone.uk), every fragrance we stock is 100% authentic and sourced directly from certified brand headquarters and primary distributors in Dubai and Europe. Each bottle comes in its original sealed manufacturer packaging with verifiable batch codes.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
items.a: We process orders quickly to ensure rapid UK delivery. If you need to make changes, please email support@perfumezone.uk within 30 minutes of placing your order with your order number, and our concierge team will do their utmost to accommodate your request.

items.q: What payment options do you accept?
items.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, and Klarna (Pay in 3 installments). We also offer Cash on Delivery for select UK mainland addresses.

items.q: How much does delivery cost, and how fast is it?
items.a: We offer FREE UK Delivery on all orders over £50 via Royal Mail Tracked 48 (2–3 business days). For orders under £50, standard shipping is £3.99. We also offer Royal Mail Tracked 24 (Next Business Day) for £5.99.

items.q: Do you deliver internationally or to Europe?
items.a: Yes, we ship to Ireland, France, Germany, Spain, Netherlands, Poland, and select other European destinations. International shipping rates and times are calculated automatically at checkout.

items.q: How can I track my package?
items.a: Once your order is dispatched from our London facility, you will receive an email and SMS with your Royal Mail tracking reference and a direct tracking link.

We offer a 14-day return policy for unopened, unsealed items in their original factory cellophane condition. Because fragrance is a personal hygiene and cosmetic product, opened or used bottles cannot be returned for hygiene reasons. Please contact support@perfumezone.uk to initiate a return authorization.

items.q: What if my bottle arrives damaged or broken?
items.a: While our insulated packaging makes transit damage extremely rare, if your item arrives damaged, please send photos of the packaging and bottle to support@perfumezone.uk within 48 hours of receipt, and we will issue an immediate replacement or full refund.

items.q: How should I store my perfumes to ensure maximum longevity?
items.a: Store your fragrance bottles in a cool, dark, and dry environment away from direct sunlight, extreme heat, and bathroom humidity. Keeping them in their original presentation box is ideal for preserving delicate top notes and essential oils.

items.q: What is the difference between Eau De Parfum and Extrait De Parfum?
items.a: Extrait De Parfum (Pure Perfume) contains the highest concentration of fragrance oils (typically 20% to 40%), providing richer sillage and up to 12-24 hours of longevity on skin. Eau De Parfum contains between 15% and 20% fragrance oil concentration, ideal for both everyday wear and evening elegance.
